course.title: Unit 1 How tall are you?-Part C--【例句】

sentences.content: The sun is getting lower and lower, but my shadow is getting longer and longer.
sentences.english: The sun is getting lower and lower , but my shadow is getting longer and longer
sentences.chinese: 太阳越来越低，但我的影子却越来越长。

sentences.content: Why is my shadow longer when the sun gets lower?
sentences.english: Why is my shadow longer when the sun gets lower ?
sentences.chinese: 为什么太阳位置越低时我的影子越长？

wordDetails.definition: get（第三人称单数）: 变得

sentences.content: Your shadow grows longer because you are growing taller.
sentences.english: Your shadow grows longer because you are growing taller
sentences.chinese: 你的影子变长是因为你在长高。

wordDetails.definition: grow（第三人称单数）: 变长

sentences.content: They need a new goalkeeper. I’d like to have a try.
sentences.english: They need a new goalkeeper . I'd like to have a try
sentences.chinese: 他们需要一名新守门员。我想试试。

sentences.content: Mr Zebra is 10 centimetres taller than Mr Deer.
sentences.english: Mr Zebra is 10 centimetres taller than Mr Deer

sentences.content: Your neck is too long. The others can’t reach you. Football needs teamwork.
sentences.english: Your neck is too long . The others can't reach you . Football needs teamwork
sentences.chinese: 你的脖子太长了，其他队员够不着你。足球需要团队合作。

sentences.content: He’s almost bigger than the goal! He’s an excellent goalkeeper.
sentences.english: He's almost bigger than the goal ! He's an excellent goalkeeper
sentences.chinese: 他几乎比球门还高大！他是位出色的守门员。
